title: Luke 21:34-36
subtitle: Saturday of the 34th Week in Ordinary Time (optional Saturday memorial of the Blessed Virgin Mary) · Rv 22:1-7; Lk 21:34-36
text: On the last day of the Church's year, Jesus warns that hearts can grow drowsy from excess and the anxieties of daily life. His remedy is simple: be vigilant at all times and pray. Advent begins tomorrow.
